knownLimits: R2 is a headless/gameplay quality gate, not broadcast or production readiness.
Cycle-fill intent is present for compatible high-occupancy states, but a dedicated Hamiltonian cycle constructor is deferred to later R2 optimization if larger-board campaigns show need.

The sandbox cannot install the planned Vitest/fast-check dependencies; the same deterministic behavioral corpus uses Node's built-in runner and must be ported without weakening when dependency installation is available.
Final art/audio/HUD, provider integrations, gifts, durable production persistence, operator dashboard, long soak and public launch remain later phases.
